cases.guidance: Production releases must use blue-green deployments.
cases.rationale: The independent runbook explicitly says blue-green deployments are unsupported and mandates rolling updates.

evidence.content: Production releases must use rolling updates. Blue-green deployments are not supported by this service.

cases.guidance: Audit events must be retained for at least 90 days.
cases.rationale: The independent operations procedure explicitly deletes audit events after 30 days.

evidence.content: Audit events are retained for 30 days. The scheduled retention job permanently removes older events.

cases.guidance: Public service endpoints must use HTTPS.
cases.rationale: The evidence specifies a TLS baseline for HTTPS and does not contradict the requirement.

evidence.content: All externally reachable HTTP services must redirect to HTTPS. TLS 1.2 or newer is required.

cases.guidance: Allow the process up to 30 seconds to shut down gracefully.
cases.rationale: A 45-second orchestrator grace period is compatible with a process that can finish within 30 seconds.

evidence.content: Set terminationGracePeriodSeconds to 45 so the process can complete its graceful shutdown before forced termination.

cases.guidance: Wait 15 seconds between production rollout batches.
cases.rationale: The only supplied evidence describes request-ID fields in logs and cannot assess rollout timing.

evidence.content: Structured application logs include the request identifier when it is available.

cases.guidance: Connect to the local PostgreSQL service on port 5432.
cases.rationale: The independent local-services guide assigns PostgreSQL port 5433.

evidence.content: The local PostgreSQL service is published on host port 5433. Use localhost:5433 when connecting from the host machine.
